sql: select h.stt_rec,h.so_ct,h.ngay_ct,h.ngay_lct,h.ma_kh,sum(d.so_luong) qty from ph81 h join ct81 d using(stt_rec) where d.ma_vt='QC7-5146-000' and h.ma_gd<>4 group by h.stt_rec,h.so_ct,h.ngay_ct,h.ngay_lct,h.ma_kh order by h.ngay_lct desc,h.ngay_ct desc,h.so_ct desc,h.stt_rec desc limit 3

select sum(d.so_luong) qty,sum(d.tien2) revenue,count(*) lines from ph81 h join ct81 d using(stt_rec) where d.ma_vt='QC7-5146-000' and h.ngay_ct between date '2026-10-01' and date '2026-10-20' and h.ma_gd<>4 and h.status in(select status from sys_dmtt where ma_ct='HDA' and post_inventory_yn=true)

select date_trunc('month',h.ngay_ct) period,sum(d.so_luong) qty,sum(d.tien2) revenue from ph81 h join ct81 d using(stt_rec) where d.ma_vt='QC7-5146-000' and h.ma_kh='KH0034' and ((h.ngay_ct between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-20') or (h.ngay_ct between date '2026-10-01' and date '2026-10-20')) and h.ma_gd<>4 and h.status in(select status from sys_dmtt where ma_ct='HDA' and post_inventory_yn=true) group by 1 order by 1
select ma_khuon,tong_so_shot,so_shot_bh from dmhosokhuon where ma_khuon='K_QC5-0980-000-V2'

select 'opening' kind,sum(ton00) qty from cdvt where ma_vt='QC7-5146-000' and nam=2026 union all select 'movement',sum(sl_nhap-sl_xuat) from ct70 where ma_vt='QC7-5146-000' and ngay_ct between date '2026-01-01' and date '2026-10-20'

select a.status_qc,count(*) labels,sum((e->>'so_luong')::numeric) qty from intem_log a cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(a.data_tem::jsonb)='array' then a.data_tem::jsonb else '[]'::jsonb end) e where a.nxt=1 and a.status='1' and e->>'ma_vt'='QC7-5146-000' group by 1
